hello.t: Hello, I'm Rosario. How can I help you?

welcome_owner.t: Welcome back. Owner mode is on, with no limits.

scanning.t: Let me look at this closely.

not_caught.t: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?

try_saying.t: You can say: is this photo real, what's in front of me, or remind me in ten minutes.

no_licence.t: This needs an active Lunara Lens plan.

allowance.t: This month's allowance is used up. It renews on the first.

offline.t: I can't reach the server right now. Everything on your phone still works.

paywall.t: Lunara Lens is a paid app. Once your payment is confirmed, everything unlocks.

activated.t: Your plan is active. Thank you.

pending.t: Thank you. Your payment is waiting for confirmation.

mark_done.t: Your photo is marked and registered.

no_mark.t: I found no Lunara Mark in this image.

emergency.t: Emergency mode. Here is your card, and I can call for help.

safe_word.t: If a caller says they're family and asks for money, ask for your safe word.

qr_found.t: I found a code. Let me check it.

link_safe.t: I don't see warning signs in this link, but stay careful.

link_risky.t: This link looks risky. Please don't open it.

goodbye.t: I'm here whenever you need me.

guide_on.t: Guide mode on. I'll describe what I see every ten seconds.

wake_on.t: Hands free is on. Just say my name.
